title: Blue to lime / Fine grain is the favorite background.
reason: Use the soft blue-to-lime transition and delicate, even analog grain as the primary background reference. The blue-and-lime editorial cover remains the preferred editorial application.
example: Selected background: exp02-gradient-02 — Blue to lime / Fine grain.

title: The blue-and-lime editorial cover is the favorite.
reason: Keep the contrast and energy of the blue-and-lime cover. The forest-and-lime editorial cover did not pop enough. Explore more gradient noise and color combinations, grainy airbrush, and forest with blues and lime. New variations remain proposals.
example: Favorite: Editorial cover / Blue + lime. Next: six gradients, six airbrush treatments, and six forest-led color studies.

title: Blue, lime, soft focus, and tactile texture.
reason: Blue and lime, soft focus, tactile texture, atmospheric abstraction beyond fields. The existing editorial pieces are too plain. Explore textured gradient backgrounds with confident editorial typography and graphics on top. The other options reviewed were not liked. Do not carry them into new work. Later, unseen drafts remain unreviewed.

title: Social should feel cultural.
reason: The announcement has the strongest atmosphere. Remove redundant logos and footer text. Explore textured photographic and abstract backgrounds beneath crisp graphics. The insight is too hard to read; the quote feels like a corporate letter.
example: One logo. Clear reading order. More atmosphere and cultural energy.

title: The show is The Recoup Podcast.
reason: The user chose a direct name that reinforces Recoup. Episode topics and guests can supply the variety and specificity.

title: Lead with the mission.
reason: Connect the technology to the people creating, owning, and investing in music.
example: Our mission is to make AI work for the people who create, own, and invest in music.

title: The project title leads the illustration.
reason: Large abstract slogans in case-study illustrations confused readers before they understood the project.
example: Royalty reporting — with smaller labels such as Statements, Receipts, and Review.

title: Call a music video a music video.
reason: Use the familiar term the audience expects.
example: A music video for your release.

title: Confidence comes from clear writing.
reason: Name the service, action, or deliverable plainly. Supporting copy should add detail.
example: Personality should come through in the directness and confidence of the writing. It shouldn’t depend on making ordinary things sound more abstract.

title: Be clear about ownership.
reason: Recoup builds working custom systems the customer owns and trains the team to use them.
example: Working custom systems you own, connected to your tools.

title: Keep one consistent logo.
reason: Mismatched symbol and wordmark sizing made some footers look wrong. The supplied exports preserve the current mark and lockup.
